issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby warning in console (shadcn Dialog a11y warning). Non-blocking; add DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Payment/Ödeme dialog to silence React warnings.

GET /api/dashboard/monthly-profit uses $lte '{month}-31' - months with 30/28/29 days work (string compare) but literally '2026-02-30' is a valid string boundary that will still include Feb 28/29 rows because '2026-02-28' <= '2026-02-31'. Safe today but fragile; consider computing actual month-end.
next_quote_number races via count_documents (pre-existing, still open from iter2).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py monthly_profit: date filter uses hard '-31' upper bound (string-compare safe but semantically odd).

email_quote fetches customer with ObjectId(doc['customer_id']) inside try/except catching all Exception - if customer_id is malformed the fallback silently sets customer=None and returns 400 'e-posta yok' rather than a clearer error; acceptable but consider explicit branch.

add_quote_payment inserts an 'auto: True' income txn without a session/transaction - if the insert_one fails after quote update, quote paid_total will diverge from cash flow. Consider try/except rollback.
compute_quote_totals still applies VAT on pre-discount subtotal (business decision from iter1, still open).
Dashboard aggregates up to 5000 txns in Python (pre-existing).
server.py file is 843 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/quotes.py, routers/email.py, etc.
